name: cut_m4_pre
doc: The cutscene mod's moment M4 (the remaster's docs/fmv_manifest.json), reached on the cartridge from a public battery save by play (no pokes): Magus (his throne room): the Lair's save point, the warp, the stairs and their fight won. tools/cutscene_moments.py plays the moment from here on both sides.
